messages:
deploybot: PRE-FLIGHT: env-parity-check failed for service=transformer. Prod missing secret key: TRANSFORMER_API_KEY_SUFFIX. Release paused.
rachel: taking ownership. @devin did we change suffix handling in the overlay for staging?
devin: yep. staging overlay now appends `-v2` to the key name via template function; prod overlay still uses the old suffixless key. I forgot to promote the overlay patch.
ops: how did staging pass smoke? was the runtime tolerant?
devin: runtime in the new image expects the suffixed secret name. Staging had the suffix applied so smoke passed. Deploybot only validated the key exists, not name pattern.
rachel: quick check: `kubectl -n ml get secret transformer-keys -o jsonpath='{.data.suffix}' | base64 --decode` -> staging: `-v2`, prod: `` (empty).
release-eng: options: 1) hotpatch prod overlay to add `-v2` suffix (requires an infra overlay change and a redeploy), 2) rollback to previous image that accepts empty suffix, 3) create a runtime fallback to try both variants (requires code change). Change window closes in 40m.
ops: hotpatch needs change to prod overlays; small, but we prefer rollback if it's faster and safer. Any estimate on overlay + redeploy time?
devin: overlay change + apply ~12m if no approvals. But redeploy will trigger the full canary path.
rachel: rollback PR ready, pin image `registry/redwood/transformer:20260315-compat`. I can open in ~8m.
ops: prefer rollback to limit risk during window. Also filing a follow-up to enhance deploybot to validate secret name patterns and decoded content.
release-eng: decision: rollback and hold promotion until 09:30UTC tomorrow. If hotpatch finishes in <10m and smoke passes, we can rescind.
devin: applying rollback: `kubectl -n ml set image deploy/transformer transformer=registry/redwood/transformer:20260315-compat`
deploybot: detected image change, running post-deploy health checks.
ops: tailing logs: `kubectl -n ml logs -l app=transformer -f --since=2m`  nothing unusual. readiness probes passing.
rachel: rollback applied; health checks green. updating release notes: "rollback: pinned transformer image due to env overlay suffix mismatch causing missing prod secret; follow-ups: deploybot pattern check + overlay promotion checklist."
release-eng: creating tickets RL-6120 (deploybot secret-name pattern check) and RL-6121 (overlay promotion playbook). Assigning to infra+devx.
devin: sorry team, will coordinate overlay promotion run next maintenance.
rachel: thanks all, closing thread once deploybot confirms final checks.
deploybot: post-deploy checks complete, thread closed.
